summary: Frontend UI + integration testing for iteration 25 changes: (1) tab/title renamed from 'Komutan Bilgileri' to 'LoJ Hakkında' in all 8 i18n locales, and (2) new 'MALİYET HESAPLAMA' sidebar section with 8 mh_* accordion sub-categories on /komutanlar. All targeted flows verified end-to-end including admin login (admin/admin123), item creation via commander-form treated as info (title + body_text, no rank/rarity/is_kof/type-chips), POST /api/commanders returning 200 with category='mh_bina', new card appearing, aggregate section-open view, empty state, regression on existing 6 sections, and language switcher.
critical_code_review_comments: Commanders.jsx is 1249 lines — over the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting CommanderForm, TeamSlotsEditor, CharacterMultiSelect, CommanderLightbox, CommanderCard, CommanderGridCard into separate files for maintainability.

isInfo logic is duplicated (Commanders.jsx line 947 in CommanderForm and line 107 in addButtonLabel) — extract into a shared helper isInfoCategory(catKey, section) to prevent drift when more info-style prefixes are added later.

Section header key MALİYET HESAPLAMA uses Turkish literal string as a lookup key across CATEGORIES/SIDEBAR_SECTION_I18N/openSectionView/data-testid. Special characters (İ, Ş) in data-testid attributes work but consider stable ASCII keys (e.g. 'maliyet_hesaplama') for section identifiers with a separate display label — safer for CSS/query selector edge cases across browsers.

success_rate.backend: n/a (not requested / verified via UI integration)
